messages:
emily: Quick FYI — planning to cut the v0.22.0 release branch at 10:00 PT tomorrow. :bell: Short checklist below, please update/confirm before cutoff.

samir: Noted. PR #4122 (optimizer tweaks) is merged to main but needs a perf smoke and changelog line.

mira: I can run the perf smoke at 08:30 PT tomorrow. @samir please add the short perf note to the changelog so I can reference it in the runbook.

alex: Quick reminder — if you're touching runtime deps, run `make dep-check` and push the SBOM to the release artifact. CI will fail otherwise.

emily: Changelog template (copy into CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased):
```
### Changed
- runtime: reduce KV cache overhead for small sequences (PR #4122) — @samir
```
Also bump version in `pkg/version.py` and `helm/Chart.yaml`.

docs: I'll take doc updates — linking to the new runtime behavior and the migration notes. ETA: 2h today.

release-captain: Here's my quick gating list (mark as you finish):
- [ ] version bump pushed
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry
- [ ] all e2e + perf smoke green
- [ ] security scan clear
- [ ] docs updated
- [ ] helm chart updated
I'll make the cut once all boxes are cleared by 09:30 PT.

security: Running SCA and secret-scan now. If anyone added new third-party libs, ping me with the manifest. Will annotate any findings in the ticket.

samir: Version bump done: `git commit -m "chore: bump v0.22.0" pkg/version.py helm/Chart.yaml` — pushed to main.

ci-bot: e2e-tests started for main — job #7821. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/7821

qa-bot: Perf smoke scheduled at 08:30 PT tomorrow. Will post summary within 15m of completion.

mira: Perf smoke note: small wins on latency for <128 tokens, 5-7% tail reduction. No regressions on throughput. Posting run log to the release ticket.

emily: Thanks — @docs please add the migration note about prefix cache behavior and a one-liner under notable-changes.

docs: Added docs snippet and link to run log. PR #4150 opened for docs with screenshots.

security: SCA returned a low-severity advisory on transitive dep foo-lib@2.3. Patch available. I recommend we apply the patch before final cut; will open a quick PR.

alex: If the patch is small and CI is green, I can squash it into the final merge. Otherwise, we should schedule a post-release patch.

release-captain: Keep me posted. If security PR blocks the cut, I'll wait up to 30m for a green CI on the patch, otherwise we'll merge with a follow-up and note it in the postmortem.

emily: Final ask — if you have any docs/QA/security blockers, drop them here by 09:00 PT so we can triage. I'll be on standby in case of merge conflicts.

samir: All done from infra side. :thumbsup:

mira: Perf smoke ✅ — no regressions. Posted details in the ticket.

qa-bot: e2e-tests passed: job #7821 ✅

security: Patch PR #4160 opened and CI passed. low-severity advisory resolved.

release-captain: All gates green. Cutting branch now and tagging `v0.22.0-rc1`. :shipit:

emily: Thanks team — I'll post release notes draft in the release ticket and ping for any late edits.
